text: Verdict rule: V1 Void is not supported for TravelportNdc on this build (TC-CAPCHECK-TPN-03), so for the cases marked "Both" the verdict follows V2 (the version that implements Void); the V1 sends are recorded alongside as evidence and are all 409 OperationNotSupported. V1-only rows (POS-01 and the four V1 flows) therefore FAIL, and the stale-token V1 flow (NEGHOP5) is BLOCKED. Because surName, bookingToken, pnr text and the voidTickets list are not validated on V2, every VAL-02/04, BND-01, NEG-02/03, SEC-04 (surName), BIZ-06 and NEGHOP6 variant voided its booking, so one fresh booking per variant was created (53 TravelportNdc bookings and holds in total, plus 2 SabreNdc bookings for REG-01). BIZ-01 and BND-02 were blocked: the 2026-10-22 leftovers no longer exist at Travelport and a midnight crossing is not possible in one session. Concurrent Holds on the same offer fail with 409 BYP-A0001; the Holds were rerun sequentially. All bookings were voided or cancelled by the end of the run (the 8 V1 bookings through the V2 Void endpoint).
